# `MotionMonitor`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

State of the motion-monitor worker (firmware 9.75, 64-bit only).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | INFERRED |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0 reports, MotionMonitor worker @0x46ccf0 (64-bit build) |

New in firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0, 64-bit build only. The function name is MotionMonitor and its state printer reports the members below. It is sent through the shared function-state envelope (the common formatter with the printer attached); exactly which states are visited is unresolved, so the state enum is INFERRED. A receiver MUST NOT depend on seeing every transition.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"MotionMonitor"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function-state name; INFERRED to follow the shared function-state formatter. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [INFERRED] |
| `mode` | string | no | - | Configured mode. One of: `auto_track`, `auto_capture`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | no | - | Worker stage. The printer's value set includes starting_track (resolver report). One of: `idle`, `detecting`, `starting_track`, `tracking`, `returning`. [READ] |
| `return_to_origin` | boolean | no | - | Configured return-to-origin flag. [READ] |
| `sensitivity` | string | no | - | Configured sensitivity. One of: `low`, `middle`, `high`. [READ] |
| `waiting_time` | integer | no | - | Configured waiting time in seconds (the time to wait for a lost target before returning; used only when return_to_origin is true). [READ] |
| `duration_min` | integer | no | - | Configured duration in minutes, -1 for unlimited. [READ] |
| `remaining_sec` | integer | no | - | Seconds remaining (unit INFERRED from the name). [READ; unit INFERRED] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.
